title: Machine Learning Specialization
description: Master machine learning fundamentals with Python, NumPy, scikit-learn, and TensorFlow. Covers supervised learning (linear & logistic regression, decision trees, neural networks), unsupervised learning (clustering, anomaly detection), and recommender systems. Taught by Andrew Ng — Stanford professor and AI pioneer.

title: Deep Learning Specialization
description: Become a deep learning expert. Build and train neural networks using TensorFlow — covering CNNs for vision, sequence models (RNNs, LSTMs, GRUs), Transformers, and NLP. Includes practical projects in speech recognition, image segmentation, and music synthesis.

title: IBM Data Science Professional Certificate
description: Launch your career as a data scientist. Master Python, SQL, machine learning, data visualization with Matplotlib and Seaborn, and big data tools. Includes 10 hands-on projects and a real-world capstone — build a rocket launch success predictor with SpaceX data.

title: Google UX Design Professional Certificate
description: Design and prototype UX solutions end-to-end. Learn the full UX process: user empathy, competitive analysis, wireframing, low and high-fidelity prototyping in Figma, and usability testing. Build a professional UX portfolio with 3 complete case studies.

title: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
description: Prepare for Google Cloud's most prestigious certification. Design, build, and manage scalable GCP solutions — covering VPC networking, Kubernetes Engine, Cloud SQL, Spanner, BigQuery, IAM, and SRE reliability practices. Includes 5 case study-based labs.

title: Meta Front-End Developer Professional Certificate
description: Become job-ready as a front-end developer. Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Redux, and testing with Jest. Build a portfolio capstone — a fully responsive web app following Meta's engineering standards. Taught by Meta software engineers.

title: Meta Back-End Developer Professional Certificate
description: Build server-side applications with Python, Django REST Framework, and MySQL. Covers REST API design, version control with Git, cloud deployments, CI/CD pipelines, and backend security — culminating in a full-stack capstone project reviewed by Meta engineers.

title: Algorithms, Part I
description: Essential computer science fundamentals from Princeton. Covers union-find, sorting algorithms (mergesort, quicksort, heapsort), priority queues, and symbol tables. Rigorous mathematical analysis alongside Java implementations. Widely regarded as the gold standard algorithms MOOC.

title: DevOps, DataOps, MLOps Specialization
description: Master DevOps engineering from CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) to container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), IaC with Terraform, and MLOps workflows. Learn to build fully automated deployment pipelines for cloud-native applications.

title: Natural Language Processing Specialization
description: Master NLP with deep learning — sentiment analysis, named entity recognition, machine translation, question answering, and text summarization. Implement attention mechanisms, transformers, and BERT from scratch using Python and TensorFlow.

title: IBM Cybersecurity Analyst Professional Certificate
description: Develop practical cybersecurity skills: threat intelligence, incident response, SIEM tools (QRadar), penetration testing, network security, and compliance frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001). Includes virtual labs and a real-world breach investigation capstone.

title: Full Stack Web Development with React Specialization
description: Build full-stack web applications from the ground up — React, Redux, React Native for cross-platform mobile, Node.js/Express REST APIs, and MongoDB. Culminates in a full-stack restaurant ordering system capstone project.
instructor: Jogesh Muppala (Hong Kong University of Science & Technology)
